name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Senior Customer Onboarding Specialist
summary: Customer Onboarding and Account Management professional with 15+ years in MarTech, SaaS, and agency environments. Owns the first 30-90 days of the post-sale journey: running onboarding calls, coordinating handoffs across customer success and technical teams, and translating complex platform capabilities into measurable value for non-technical stakeholders. Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners at roughly 94% retention, ran Salesforce reporting cadences, and led and trained onboarding teams of up to 20.
